title: Excavation & Site Preparation
description: Small excavation projects, site grading, trenching and preparation for property improvements. We use compact equipment to work efficiently where access is limited.

title: Driveway Repairs & Gravel Resurfacing
description: Repair worn gravel driveways, address potholes and low spots, improve drainage and refresh surfaces with suitable aggregate. Work is assessed for access and ground conditions.

title: Lawn Care & Maintenance
description: Routine lawn mowing, trimming, seasonal yard care and general grounds upkeep for residential and commercial properties. Ask about recurring service arrangements.

title: Deck Building & Repair
description: New deck construction, replacement of deteriorated boards, railings and steps, and repairs to existing outdoor spaces, subject to applicable permits and building requirements.

title: Gutter Cleaning
description: Removal of leaves and debris from accessible gutters and downspout openings, plus a visual check for obvious drainage concerns.

title: Chimney Cleaning
description: Chimney cleaning inquiries and maintenance coordination, subject to equipment, access and applicable qualifications. Inspection or certification is not implied.

title: Drainage Trenching & Improvements
description: Small drainage trenches, surface-water diversion, gravel drainage improvements and drainage preparation. We assess slope, soil, utilities and appropriate discharge locations.
full: Drainage trenching and small drainage improvements

title: Stump Removal & Property Cleanup
description: Small stump and root removal where feasible, brush and debris cleanup, yard clearing and site tidying to prepare properties for their next use.

title: Shed & Garage Pad Preparation
description: Excavation and preparation of compacted granular bases for sheds, garages and outbuildings, according to the project requirements and approved plans.

title: Contractor Excavation Support
description: Compact excavator and operator support for contractors needing assistance with trenching, material movement, small excavations or site preparation.

title: Material Delivery & Debris Removal
description: Delivery of suitable bulk materials and removal of permitted debris using a pickup and dump trailer, with disposal and hauling arranged for the job.

title: General Handyman Services
description: General property repairs, fixture and hardware replacement, minor carpentry and practical maintenance tasks that do not require specialized trade licensing.

title: Barn Repair
description: Practical repairs and maintenance for barns and rural outbuildings, including siding, doors, boards and minor non-structural repairs. Structural work is assessed separately.

title: Residential & Commercial Cleaning
description: Property cleaning, move-in or move-out cleaning, common-area cleaning and general interior or exterior cleaning arrangements tailored to the site.

title: Water & Sewer Service Replacement
description: Excavation and support for water and sewer service replacement projects, coordinated with the appropriate licensed trades, utility locates, permits and inspections.

title: Residential & Commercial Property Maintenance
description: Ongoing property upkeep, seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, grounds care and tailored maintenance arrangements for homes, businesses and rural properties.
